name: AgriRiskRuleEngine
description: Rule-based thresholds for precision agricultural risk assessment and real-time farmer alerts

advisory.critical: Urgent irrigation required! Soil moisture has dropped below critical root uptake threshold.
advisory.warning: Soil moisture trending low. Schedule irrigation within 24 to 48 hours.
advisory.optimal: Soil moisture levels are within optimal range. No irrigation required today.

mild_stress.action: Implement moisture conservation techniques (mulching, inter-cultivation) and deficit drip irrigation.

moderate_drought.action: Prioritize critical crop growth stages for irrigation. Apply anti-transpirants or shade netting if viable.

severe_drought.action: Immediate contingency irrigation required. Trigger state drought assistance notifications.

advisory.flash_flood: Heavy downpour alert. Clear farm drainage trenches immediately and protect harvested produce.
advisory.waterlogging_risk: Soil reached full saturation with stagnant water risk. Facilitate surface runoff to prevent root rot and hypoxia.

heatwave.action: Apply light, frequent sprinkler irrigation in early mornings or evenings. Protect nursery and flowering crops.

frost_and_coldwave.action: Light nighttime irrigation or smoke generation around orchard borders to raise ambient micro-climate temperatures.

high_wind_storm.action: Provide staking to tall crops (banana, sugarcane, maize, tomato) and postpone chemical spraying.

fungal_blight_risk.action: Microclimate favors rapid spore germination. Inspect leaf undersides and apply preventive bio-fungicide.
